book.name: 1 Amǝ Korinti
book.title: Cauterǝa mǝdǝmbe mala Bulǝs aban ká a ban AMƏ KORINTI

content: Ramnggi ɓoro ace aɓwana mala Ɓakuli
Amur cau mala ramgi ɓoro ace bwalì aɓwana mala Ɓakuli mǝnana a Urǝshalima ka: Wu pa kǝla mǝnana ǝn kania a'ikǝlisiya mǝnana a Galati ka.

A tita pwari mala koya nre-limo ka, koyan atà wun ngga, ɓǝ̀ san nkanggari boalo mǝnana kúmô sǝ kārǝa arǝ kume male ka ɓǝ̀ tsǝì. Wu kǝa kúndǝô ama she mǝ yina ka sǝ wun nǝ̀ yia ramgi a kun-bu wun ɗàng.
Ɓǝ̀ ǝn yina ka, mǝ nǝ yia gilǝ acauterǝa amur aɓwana mǝnana wu earnǝia ama ɓǝa kyan nǝ ɓoro ma'wun a Urǝshalima ka.
Sǝ ɓǝ̀ yi dumǝna ama ɓoaro male ka mǝ kyan ngga, sǝm nǝ̀ ongsǝ sǝnǝia.
Kànì mǝnana a ɓabum Bulǝsace gya male ka
Mǝ nǝ ká a makka wun kun, anzǝm mǝnana ɓǝn karna aɓa nzali Masǝdoniya ka. Acemǝnana kànì mem ngga, nda mǝnana ama mǝ nǝ pǝlǝa aɓa Masǝdoniya.
Earka mǝ nǝ duk zuku aban wun, ko yakǝla mǝ nǝ mal mbulo kat aban wun, anzǝm man ngga sǝ wu nǝ̀ pusǝkwar-muram aban lidǝmba nǝ gya mem.
Eare mem ngga, nǝma pa mǝ nǝ sǝn wun a murkuli ɗang, nǝma ɓǝ̀ banem sauwa aban wun, ɓǝ̀ Mǝtalabangŋo ear ka.
Sǝ ado ka, mǝ nǝ nggá duk zuku a Afisu she ɓǝ̀ Lamsan Pentikos karna ka.
Anjar mala pakki atúró na pas kani, sǝama aɓibura gbal ka, à cambam kingging.
Ɓǝ̀ Timoti yina ka, wu é nǝ banɓoarnado. Yì ka, túró mala Mǝtalabangŋo na pakkiyi, kǝla mǝnana ǝn pakkiyi ka.
Wu kǝa eare ɓǝ̀ kǝɓwa nyesǝi ɓà ɗàng. Ɓǝ̀ nǝ̀ nyare aban yiu abanam ngga, wu pusǝbǝri pepe. Mǝ nda aban kundǝmuri andǝ amǝ'eamrǝarǝu.
Mala mǝ'eam sǝm kǝla Apolo ka, ǝn camarǝ ne wi nǝma yì andǝ aɓea amǝ'eamrǝarǝu ka, ɓǝa kya ban wun. Sǝ ado ka, kǝ ear ama nǝ̀ ká ɗàng. Nǝ̀ ká nǝnzǝ́mò ɓǝ̀ kumǝna dǝmbu ka.
Wu do aɓa kwaro mala dǝm wun. Wu tamsǝkusǝ wun kàngkàng aɓa paɓamuru. Wu pak aburana. Wu dum nǝ rǝcandǝa.
Ko man wu nǝ̀ pak ka wu pe aɓa earcearǝu.
Wu sǝlǝna ama Sǝtifanas andǝ ɓala male ka, à nda ka amǝdǝmba ak cau mala Ɓakuli a nzali Akaya, sǝ à pana ɓamuria arǝ túró ace aɓwana mala Ɓakuli. Ən nggǝ zǝmba wun, wun amǝ'eambǝam,
wu okia aɓwana kǝla amǝnia, andǝ koya ɓwa na mǝnana kǝ pak túró, sǝ kǝ pa rǝcandǝa aɓa kpapi atà túró ka.
Banɓoaram nǝ yiu mala Sǝtifanas, sǝ Fotunatus, sǝ Akaikus. À yì lumsǝna kun túró mǝnana nongŋo acemǝnana wu pa kani raka.
Yia ka, à nongsǝam ɓabumam andǝ ɓabum wun gbal. Aɓwana mǝnana à kǝ pak túró mǝ'mǝsǝcau nì kǝla amǝnia ka, ɓalǝ wun ɓǝ̀ kǝa lórǝiǎ ɗang.
Masǝlǝata makkun mala Bulǝs
A'ikǝlisiya mǝnana a bu-nzali Asiya ka, à kǝ makka wun kun. Akila andǝ Pǝrisǝla, andǝ ikǝlisiya mǝnana kpapiyi a ɓala malea ka, à kǝ makka wun kun, nǝ earcearǝu mala Mǝtalabangŋo.
Amǝ'eamrǝarǝu mǝnana a kani kat ka, à kǝ makka wun kun. Wu makkia rǝ wun kún kat nǝ earcearǝu mǝfele mala amǝkwaɗi.
Mim Bulǝs, mǝ nda ǝn gilǝa wun mǝnia yì makkun ngga nǝ buam.
Ɓǝ̀ kǝɓwa kǝ earce Mǝtalabangŋo raka, ɓǝ̀ súban sulǝo amur ɓwe! Marana tha - Mǝtala sǝm, yiu!
Ɓǝ̀ ɓwamuru mala Mǝtalabangŋo Yesu, do atà wun.
Ən nggǝ makka wun kun nǝ earcearǝu aɓa lullǝ Kǝrǝsti Yesu. Ɓǝ̀ do anggo.
